帳號例如 p001，密碼隨機 8 碼。: Usernames look like p001; passwords are 8 random characters.
刪除帳號 {u} 與其檢查紀錄？: Delete account {u} and its check records?
只列出尚未綁定編號的帳號: Only accounts not yet bound to an ID are listed
真的要刪除所有作答者的實例？作答內容會消失！: Really delete ALL participant instances? All work in them will be lost!
PVE 從同一範本 clone 會排隊（每個約 7 秒），60 人同時開題最慢要: PVE queues clones from the same template (about 7 s each), so 60 participants opening a question at once may wait several minutes.
刪除此實例（等同作答者重置）？: Delete this instance (same as a participant reset)?
對本題組所有作答者的實例執行最終校驗？: Run final grading on all participant instances in this set?
開放時間內第一次進入題組／開題／按檢查的時間: First time the participant entered the set, opened a question or checked during the open window
IP（多個 IP 可能是換電腦或代登）: IP (multiple IPs may mean a changed computer or someone else logging in)
zip 內含 question.yaml、description.md、setu: The zip contains question.yaml, description.md, setup.yml, check.yml (optional: solution.yml, files/).
上傳相同 id 會覆蓋（舊版備份到 data/question_backups）: Uploading the same id overwrites it (the old version is backed up to data/question_backups). See questions/README.md for the format.
配分、限時、是否開放請到「題組」頁設定: Set points, time limits and availability on the Question sets page
題庫是空的，請上傳題目包。: The question bank is empty. Please upload a question package.
作答者可見（取消勾選 = 草稿，作答者看不到）: Visible to participants (unchecked = draft, hidden from participants)
題組公告（作答者在題目列表上方看到）: Set notice (shown to participants above the question list)
只採計結束後「最終校驗」: Only the final grading after the end
單題限時的題目一律取作答時間內的最高分。: Timed questions always use the best score within the answering time.
作答者可看到每個檢查項目是否通過: Participants can see whether each check item passed
關閉時作答者只看到總分。練習建議開啟。: When off, participants only see the total score. Recommended on for practice.
Ctrl+V、右鍵、拖放都會被擋，伺服器端也會丟棄並記錄。中文輸入法一次送出多個: Ctrl+V, right-click and drag-and-drop are blocked, and the server also drops and logs pastes. An IME sending several characters at once is also treated as a paste.
勾選「納入」並儲存，該題就會出現在這個題組。單題限時 0 = 不限時（在題組開放: Check "Include" and save to add the question to this set. Time limit 0 = untimed (answer freely while the set is open).
限時題目可以開始作答的次數，0 = 不限: How many times a timed question can be started, 0 = unlimited
為所有帳號預先建立本題組所有題目的環境（每個約 7 秒，背景執行）？: Prewarm environments for every question in this set for all accounts (about 7 s each, runs in background)?
刪除本題組所有作答者的環境？（成績紀錄保留）: Delete all participant environments in this set? (score records are kept)
刪除此題組所有實例: Delete all instances of this set
刪除題組與其所有成績紀錄？: Delete this set and all its score records?
輸入題組名稱確認: Type the set name to confirm
新題組預設不公開，設定好題目與時間後再勾選「作答者可見」。練習預設：顯示檢查細項: New sets are hidden by default; check "Visible to participants" after setting questions and times. Practice defaults: show check details, allow paste, 10 s cooldown.
首頁公告（作答者登入後所有頁面上方看到）: Site notice (shown at the top of every page after participants log in)
開新題目超過上限時，最久沒用的環境會被暫停（內容保留）。跨題組計算。: When opening a question exceeds the limit, the least recently used environment is paused (contents kept). Counted across sets.
作答者和管理者都可以在右上角自行切換語言。: Participants and administrators can switch language at the top right.
立即結束這次作答並重置環境？: End this attempt now and reset the environment?
清除 {qid} 已結束的作答紀錄，讓作答者可以重新作答？: Clear finished attempts of {qid} so the participant can answer again?
每次練習的出席與得分: Attendance and scores for each practice
出席 = 該題組開放時間內有進入題組、開題、連終端機或按檢查（只登入不算）。: Present = entered the set, opened a question, connected a terminal or checked during the open window (logging in alone does not count).
預設列出所有練習題組，依開始時間排序。: All practice sets are listed by default, sorted by start time.
出席判定與晚到才有依據，結束後作答者也不能再檢查，成績就固定了。: so attendance and lateness can be determined; after the end participants can no longer check, so scores are fixed.
沒有已綁定編號的作答者: No participants bound to an ID
請先建立題組: Please create a question set first
已建立（目前未公開，設定好後勾選「作答者可見」）: Created (currently hidden; check "Visible to participants" when ready)
結束時間必須晚於開始時間: End time must be later than start time
此題組還有作答者的實例，請先「刪除此題組所有實例」: This set still has participant instances; use "Delete all instances of this set" first
請輸入題組名稱確認刪除: Type the set name to confirm deletion
題組「{name}」與其成績紀錄已刪除: Set "{name}" and its score records deleted
開始建置（約 1~5 分鐘），本頁可重新整理查看紀錄: Build started (about 1–5 minutes); refresh this page to see the log
上傳成功；若 setup 有變更請重新建置範本: Upload succeeded; rebuild the template if setup changed
仍有作答者的實例，請先到「實例」頁刪除: Participant instances still exist; delete them on the Instances page first
此帳號還有實例，請先刪除實例: This account still has instances; delete them first
題組尚未結束；請先結束再做最終校驗: The set has not ended; end it before final grading
實例總數會達到 {n}，超過上限 {limit}（目前 {cur}）。請先刪除已: Total instances would reach {n}, above the limit of {limit} (currently {cur}). Delete the instances of finished question sets first, or raise the limit in Settings.
為已綁定編號的帳號預先建立本題組所有題目的環境（每個約 7 秒，背景執行）？: Pre-create environments for every question in this set for all accounts bound to an ID (about 7 s each, runs in background)?
包含尚未綁定編號的帳號: Include accounts not yet bound to an ID
每個實例佔一個磁碟（LVM），全系統可容納的數量有限：題組結束、成績確定後請刪除: Each instance uses one disk (LVM) and the system can only hold a limited number: once a set is over and grades are final, delete its instances.
全系統實例：{n} / 上限 {limit}。題組結束、成績確定後，請到題組頁刪: Instances system-wide: {n} / limit {limit}. When a set is over and grades are final, delete its instances on the set page to free space.
預先建立時檢查。每個實例佔一個 LVM 磁碟，PVE 預設的 LVM metad: Checked when pre-creating. Each instance uses one LVM disk; PVE's default LVM metadata holds roughly 1100 disks.
建議測驗前（可前一天）到「題組」頁該測驗按「預先建立實例」，測驗開始時作答者只需: Before an assessment (even the day before), open the assessment on the Question sets page and click "Prewarm instances"; participants then only need to start them (about 4 s).
練習與測驗的環境是分開的；練習用完可在題組頁「刪除此題組所有實例」釋放空間。: Practice and assessment environments are separate; after practice, use "Delete all instances of this set" on the set page to free space.
測驗結束後才能執行: Available only after the assessment ends
練習（不計入測驗；時間可不限）: Practice (not counted as assessment; time may be unlimited)
測驗（需設定時間；結束後停止環境、可最終校驗）: Assessment (time required; environments stop at the end, final grading available)
練習題組時間可留空：開始留空 = 立即開放，結束留空 = 一直開放。測驗題組兩個: Practice sets may leave times empty: empty start = open now, empty end = open indefinitely. Assessment sets require both.
測驗前建議先預先建立，測驗開始時作答者只需要啟動。練習通常不需要預先建立（第一次: Prewarm before an assessment so participants only need to start instances. Practice usually does not need it (first open takes about 10–30 s).
每個題組有自己的題目、配分、開放時間與作答規則。作答者的環境與成績分題組記錄：同: Each set has its own questions, points, open window and rules. Participant environments and scores are kept per set: the same question in a practice set and an assessment set has separate environments and scores.
任何一場測驗進行中時，練習題組會自動暫停: While any assessment is in progress, practice sets are paused automatically
（練習環境停止、終端機斷線），測驗結束後恢復。: (practice environments stop and terminals disconnect), and resume after the assessment.
測驗/練習的時間、計分方式、禁止貼上等，改到「題組」頁分別設定。: Assessment/practice times, scoring policy, paste blocking etc. are set per set on the Question sets page.
（測驗題組需要設定開始與結束時間，作答者才能作答）: (assessment sets need start and end times before participants can answer)
欄位依序：帳號, 密碼, 編號, 備註（只有帳號必填）。密碼留空會隨機產生；有填: Columns in order: username, password, ID, note (only username is required). Empty passwords are generated randomly; rows with an ID are bound immediately; a header row is skipped.
還沒有任何題組。成績總覽會顯示題組的成績，請依下列步驟建立第一個題組：: There are no question sets yet. The overview shows the scores of a set — follow these steps to create your first one:
：每一題按「建置範本＋自我測試」: : press "Build template + self-test" for each question
：新增題組、放入題目，並勾選「作答者可見」: : create a set, add questions and check "Visible to participants"
（練習可以不設時間；測驗要設定開始與結束時間）: (practice sets may have no times; assessment sets need a start and end time)
：批次產生或匯入 CSV，列印發給作答者: : generate accounts or import a CSV, then print them for participants
用另一個瀏覽器（或無痕視窗）以作答者身分登入，綁定編號後開題試做: Log in as a participant in another browser (or a private window), bind an ID and try a question
回到這裡看成績、出席與運作中的環境: Come back here to see scores, attendance and running environments
完整說明見管理者操作手冊（docs/ADMIN.md）。: See the administrator guide (docs/ADMIN.md) for details.
每次連上終端機會產生一筆紀錄。刪除帳號或題組時，相關紀錄會一併刪除。: Each terminal connection creates one recording. Recordings are deleted together with the account or question set.
閒置超過 2 秒的片段會縮短。進度條上的標記是每一行輸入；點右邊的列表可以跳到該: Idle periods longer than 2 seconds are shortened. Markers on the progress bar are input lines; click an entry in the list to jump to it.
用逗號分隔。會直接改寫這題的 question.yaml（匯出 zip 也會帶著: Separate with commas. This rewrites the question's question.yaml directly (exported zips include it); if you keep questions in git, sync the change back, or the next push-questions.sh will overwrite it.
移出只是不納入，該題的配分、限時等設定會保留。: Removing only excludes the question; its points, time limit and other settings are kept.
tags 必須是清單，例如 tags: [systemd, network]: tags must be a list, e.g. tags: [systemd, network]
無法安全地改寫 question.yaml 的 tags，請直接編輯檔案: Could not safely rewrite tags in question.yaml; edit the file directly
「{what}」還有尚未儲存的修改，這次不會一起儲存。仍要繼續嗎？: "{what}" has unsaved changes that will not be saved with this. Continue anyway?
作答者看得到這個題組: participants can see this question set
作答者第一次開題時系統會自動建立環境（約 10~30 秒），所以這一步不是必要的: Environments are created automatically the first time a participant opens a question (about 10–30 seconds), so this step is optional.
勾選「納入」的題目會出現在這個題組。改完按最下面的「儲存題目設定」，整張表一次儲: Questions with "Include" ticked appear in this question set. When you are done, press "Save question settings" at the bottom to save the whole table at once. Time limit 0 = untimed (free work within the set's open window); attempts 0 = unlimited.
只儲存這一段（名稱、時間、公開、計分方式等），題目在下一段另外儲存。: Saves only this section (name, times, visibility, scoring, …); questions are saved separately in the next section.
每個實例佔一個磁碟（LVM），全系統可容納的數量有限：題組結束、成績確定後請刪除: Each instance uses one disk (LVM) and the system can hold only a limited number: delete a set's instances once it is over and scores are final. Scores are kept.
測驗前建議；練習通常不需要: recommended before an assessment; usually not needed for practice
測驗時很多人同時開題會排隊，建議在帳號都綁定編號、題目確定之後先建立好，測驗開始: When many people open questions at the start of an assessment they queue up, so create them in advance once accounts are bound and questions are final; participants then only need to start them.
測驗需要設定開始與結束時間: an assessment needs start and end times
